newsitem.title: UK: CRICKET-FIRST DAY OF LORD'S TEST WASHED OUT.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-FIRST DAY OF LORD'S TEST WASHED OUT.

text.p: Light but steady rain forced the umpires to call off play on the first day of the second test between England and Australia at Lord's on Thursday without a ball being bowled.
After overnight rain had soaked the outfield, umpires Sri Venkataraghavan and David Shepherd announced they would inspect the pitch after the lunch interval.
Late in the morning the rain stopped and the sun shone briefly, raising hopes that there would be play after lunch.
The covers were taken off the pitch and surrounding areas and both teams practised but the rain then set in again shortly before the umpires were due to inspect.
Play was finally called off just before five p.m. (1600 GMT).
